$description: Aerie, the shell kit: the water, the band, the focal point and the layers the shell alone draws. Edit tokens here only; scripts/build-tokens.mjs generates everything else.

floor-you-low.$description: Floors: the lower, larger glow bands of the water on your own floor. The same as navy, so your own floor looks as the shell always has. Light, never ink.

floor-department-low.$description: Floors: the lower glow bands on the floors of the first level of team below the org (called Department unless an admin renames it): a deep violet, so a department never looks like a team below it. Light, never ink.

floor-team-low.$description: Floors: the lower glow bands on every team's floor: a warm coral, one colour for every team below the first level (departments have their own) so it always means "shared with my team". Light, never ink; teams are told apart by name and breadcrumb.

floor-org-low.$description: Floors: the lower glow bands on the org's floor, a deep navy that reads as the deepest, quietest water. Light, never ink.

water-deep-ocean-navy.$description: The water, Deep Ocean preset: the lower, navy bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-deep-ocean-green.$description: The water, Deep Ocean preset: the upper, green bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-deep-ocean-slate.$description: The water, Deep Ocean preset: the centre of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-deep-ocean-slate-deep.$description: The water, Deep Ocean preset: the edge of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-aurora-navy.$description: The water, Aurora preset: the lower, navy bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-aurora-slate.$description: The water, Aurora preset: the centre of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-aurora-slate-deep.$description: The water, Aurora preset: the edge of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-sonar-line-navy.$description: The water, Sonar Line preset: the lower, navy bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-sonar-line-slate-deep.$description: The water, Sonar Line preset: the edge of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-minimal-slate.$description: The water, Minimal preset: the centre of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

water-minimal-slate-deep.$description: The water, Minimal preset: the edge of the ground behind the bands. Where this preset matches Calm Tide it uses navy, green, slate and slate-deep instead. The still horizon replaces the water later.

glow-blur.$description: Blur on the band canvas. Higher is softer (Minimal uses 40px); lower draws lines (Sonar Line uses 6px).

glow-saturate.$description: Saturation boost on the band canvas.

grain-opacity.$description: Opacity of the fractal-noise grain laid over everything.

breathe.$description: How far each band's intensity swells and fades (0 = steady).

band-top.$description: Height of the top band. Holds chrome (name left, status right) and nothing else; view headings start at its foot.

band-bottom.$description: Height of the bottom band. Holds the ask line and the Esc key; content stops above it.

anchor-ask.$description: Distance of the ask line from the bottom edge.

anchor-back.$description: Distance of the Esc key and key hints from the bottom edge.

focal.$description: The focal point: the menu's focused item and any centred glance sit on it. Centred blocks sit 4% high of it (optical centre).

letterbox.$description: Height of each letterbox bar in the Title layouts.

layer-glance.$description: A Glance, with its veil, over the menu.

travel-floor.$description: How far the screen travels between floors: away the way you're going, in from the other side. Under reduced motion nothing travels; it crossfades.

motion-title.$description: How long an area title card stays: arriving on a floor or opening an app. Any key, press or scroll ends it sooner.

motion-toast.$description: How long a toast stays before it goes by itself. Hovering or focusing it holds it; anything with an Undo stays this long at least.
